material_findings.title: Kind-bearing validation descriptor is rejected by the pinned loader
material_findings.effect: All successfully initialized blocks fail before any continuation fit, making the twelve-fit development trigger unevaluable.
material_findings.fix: Pass the already-bound context validation descriptor or a path/sha256/optional-bytes projection to driver.load_labels; retain the kind-bearing scope/preservation record.
material_findings.focused_evidence: All three sealed validation descriptors rejected by extracted stdlib-only pinned verifier before any numeric hash/open callback.

material_findings.title: Transitive paired base import is outside source custody
material_findings.effect: The actual imported source copy is not checked before import or in original preservation; its manifest is hashed but its payload is not verified.
material_findings.fix: Bind the exact paired base descriptor in frozen original source/preservation records, verifying before import and after execution.
